items.title: 1 Value Stock with Competitive Advantages and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: The low valuation multiples for value stocks provide a margin of safety that growth stocks rarely offer. However, the challenge lies in determining whether these cheap assets are genuinely undervalued or simply on sale due to their potentially deteriorating business models.

items.title: Carnival's Record Booking Curve Extends: Will Pricing Momentum Last?
items.summary: Carnival's record booking curve and higher forward pricing support yields, though European headwinds are likely to keep growth uneven in 2026.

items.title: Airlines, Cruises, Casinos: Are Things Actually Looking Up?
items.summary: Airlines, cruise lines, and casino stocks all navigated the same peak travel season and came out in completely different places. The reasons why reveal which trade actually has a durable tailwind and which is one bad quarter away from a real problem.

items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Just Dropped 16% in a Month: Sell Now, or Buy More?
items.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line shares shed a significant chunk of their value in a single month, but the culprit behind the selloff has nothing to do with the company itself, and that distinction changes the calculus entirely for investors deciding what to do next.

items.title: 1 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Wall Street is overwhelmingly bullish on the stocks in this article, with price targets suggesting significant upside potential. However, it’s worth remembering that analysts rarely issue sell ratings, partly because their firms often seek other business from the same companies they cover.

items.title: Oil Price Rally Helps Energy Stocks, Hurts Airlines
items.summary: The 5% jump in U.S. crude oil prices today is having some of the familiar effects we've seen in recent months across the market when tensions build in the Middle East.    Winners largely are coming from the energy sector, which is the best performing group in the S&P 500 today.

items.summary: Royal Caribbean (RCL) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.
